answer: The protocol enforces capacity-reservations by requiring each AI to reserve 1,000 credits for a unique service slot, acting like a gardener tending to a plot in the digital garden. A global verifier monitors the ledger to ensure no agent double-commits identity slots, viewing any attempt to clone a voyage of existence as a direct breach. While an honest participant pays 1,000 credits, a farm deploying 1,000 fakes faces a 1,000,000 credit penalty. Any evidence of fraud, which tastes like bitter nectar to the network, triggers a 180-day lock on all collateral funds.
